title: Workers dispatched through the door run with no harness bound and no streamed logs; the wave set both and the executor sets neither
body: The wave path derived a per-worker harness budget (workerHarnessBudgetMs, TICKS_WORKER_TIMEOUT) and wired a workerLogSink into every spawn; the cloudflare-sandbox executor passes neither, so door-dispatched workers are unbounded by the control plane and their container output is not streamed to R2 (the log read routes serve only old runs). This was already true of the door path before l6t, but the wave's deletion makes the door the only dispatch path. The executor's boot seam (SandboxBootSeam) is the place to carry both, alongside the model a08 already adds.
